purpose: Recover stable read-only routes to customer setup dependency pages that direct page-id navigation opened as Role Center.
businessPurpose: Customer setup values must not be guessed. Before assigning posting groups, VAT groups or payment terms to U-CUST-100, the actual setup pages must be visible and explained from the real Business Central UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Each recovered page is accepted only if screenshot text and Page Inspection show the requested setup page.
Business Manager Role Center screenshots are rejected as setup proof.
Tell-Me/search overlays and generic search categories are rejected as setup proof.
Unrelated dialogs such as Power BI setup are rejected as setup proof and must be closed safely.
No setup, master data, document, preview, posting, payment or API shortcut is changed.
The customer setup value write gate remains blocked until General Business Posting Groups is recovered or explicitly parked with a safer Foundation alternative.
stopIf: The active instance or company is not clearly playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
The route requires selecting or saving a setup value.
The UI opens an unexpected page and Page Inspection cannot clarify it.
routeLearning: The page/report explorer route can recover setup pages that direct page-id navigation and broad Tell-Me categories miss. It recovered Debitorenbuchungsgruppen, MwSt.-Geschaeftsbuchungsgruppen and Zahlungsbedingungen. Geschaeftsbuchungsgruppen still needs a better exact-search term or alternate navigation route.
nextRouteHypotheses: For Geschaeftsbuchungsgruppen, use a different exact term such as Allgemeine Geschaeftsbuchungsgruppen, Buchungsgruppen or Gen. Bus. Posting Groups instead of repeating broad category clicks.
Keep using page/report explorer screenshots because it produced real setup pages for 3/4 dependencies.
Accept a page only when screenshot text and Page Inspection prove the actual setup list; Tell-Me overlay remains blocker evidence only.
